prompts.journey: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-width interactive reading journey map artwork for a polished Korean elementary reading web app, not a UI screenshot. Create ONE beautiful richly hand-painted landscape image, wide 16:9. Art direction: contemporary illustrated children's literature, gouache and colored pencil on warm ivory paper, finely layered organic textures, confident elegant shapes and storybook architectural details; charming for ages 6–12 without looking like preschool clipart. Scene: a magical but believable Jeju coastal reading village, dark volcanic-stone walls, sage forest, turquoise sea along the right edge, golden grass, persimmon roofs, soft late-afternoon sunlight. A cream meandering footpath connects FIVE distinct story destinations across the image: at 15% x / 53% y a large open book under a generous reading tree and tiny wooden library; at 35% x / 31% y a small coral-red post office with envelopes; at 53% x / 60% y a circular discussion clearing with stools and two tiny readers; at 73% x / 37% y a little open-air theater with burgundy curtains; at 87% x / 67% y an airy book-making studio with pencils, paper and a chimney. Make each destination recognizable as a real illustrated place, NOT an icon in a badge. Preserve airy low-detail zones directly below each destination so HTML labels can be overlaid. Fill the entire canvas with this richly composed landscape; no floating isolated island, no large plain border. Harmonious warm cream, deep pine, sage, ochre, sea teal, muted coral, with enough contrast and saturation to feel alive. Add discreet story details: envelopes carried by breeze, a walking path through grass, flowers, distant hills, a couple of very small children; sophisticated book-jacket quality. No words, no typography, no numbers, no logos, no UI controls, no repeated panels, no computer or phone frame, no vector/SVG look, no generic stock illustration.
prompts.coast: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-bleed portrait 4:5 book-cover painting that also works as a reading illustration; NOT a book mockup, NOT a UI screenshot. A beautifully crafted contemporary Korean children's picture-book illustration, hand-painted gouache with colored-pencil marks and tactile matte paper grain, lush but controlled details, expressive environmental storytelling for ages 6–12. Scene: Aewol, Jeju imagined coastal village in late-afternoon light. An East Asian girl about nine with a short dark bob, ochre-yellow coat and teal satchel stands beside a weathered red postbox in a volcanic-stone wall, holding a small cream envelope with a tiny blue wave drawing, looking thoughtfully toward the sea. Sea breeze carries one or two blank envelopes through the sky; silver grasses, small wildflowers, winding stone path, tangerine tree, sea turquoise and distant soft blue hills. Use a compelling diagonal composition: girl and postbox in lower right-center, sea stretching left; spacious warm pale cream sky in upper 25 percent for HTML book title overlay. Rich pine green, muted coral red, sea teal, butter yellow, apricot light; atmospheric shadows and tangible brushwork. Quiet wonder, kind and adventurous, literary and collectible. No printed words anywhere, no letters or logos, no border, no fake book spine, no interface, no flat geometric vector look, no 3D plastic rendering. The top should remain light enough for a dark green title, the lower scene fully detailed.

prompts.mail: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one complete landscape 3:2 scene from an original Korean children's picture book.
